name: Just Madness: Earth Apocalypse 1979
storyline: Set in a brutal, radioactive wasteland after a devastating global event, Just Madness follows the story of Max, a desperate father on a mission to rescue his kidnapped daughter from a ruthless gang. Players must survive the extreme elements of a post-apocalyptic world in 1979, fight off grotesque mutant creatures, and navigate dangerous factions. Through a blend of first and third-person action and deep RPG choices, every decision shapes the grim destiny of the wasteland.
summary: The world ended. The madness began. As Max, survive a brutal, radioactive wasteland to save your kidnapped daughter from a ruthless gang. Fight radiation, explore a dangerous open world in 1st/3rd person, and make choices that shape your destiny in this dark RPG survival.
